notes: Settings.s12 (Controls) + Game_controls.s5 (Keyboard). Spacebar-continue and number-key option selection are the concrete wiki-grounded techniques for moving through Tutorial Island's dialogue-heavy instructors quickly — mouse-clicking the same prompts works identically but is slower. Run toggle itself is largely moot on Tutorial Island (short walking distances, no run energy pressure) but worth setting once here since it carries to the mainland.

left-click a tile on the ground to walk the path toward the Survival Expert

receive a small fishing net
use the small fishing net on the nearby fishing spot -> catch raw shrimps (Fishing xp)
notes: Tutorial_Island.s1, Survival Expert. Instructions given to the character appear in the top-left corner; the skills interface shows current level/xp per skill.

receive a bronze axe and a tinderbox
use the bronze axe on the nearby tree -> collect logs (Woodcutting xp)
select the tinderbox, then use it on the logs -> light a fire (Firemaking xp)
notes: Tutorial_Island.s1. Nearby oak trees are visible but not choppable (require Woodcutting 15, above the level-3 cap available on the island).

eat the cooked shrimps to restore health (optional — health cannot reach 0 on Tutorial Island)
notes: Tutorial_Island.s1. Almost every survival skill here caps at level 3, and everything gathered on Tutorial Island is lost on leaving the island — for a speedrun-efficient line, do the single required gather/cook/eat cycle and move on rather than farming extra shrimps.

talk to Lev, the Master Chef
receive a pot of flour and a bucket of water
use the pot of flour on the bucket of water (or vice versa) -> bread dough
use the bread dough on the cooking range -> bake bread (Cooking xp)
notes: Tutorial_Island.s5. '??' flag: the wiki's own wording on ingredient replenishment ('Lev will replenish ingredients, but only if you didn't complete the music tutorial... if you didn't complete the music tutorial, you can't burn your bread') is internally unclear about ordering — not resolved here per own-words/'??'-over-guessing discipline; does not block progression (dough->bread only needs one pass).

atoms: open the Music Player and select/play a track to complete the music-player prompt
notes: Tutorial_Island.s5. Completing this unlocks emotes and the run-toggle option when moving on to the next building — a required gate, not a detour, despite reading as optional.

atoms: enter Building three: the quest house
talk to the Quest Guide
listen to the quest-journal colour explanation (red = not started, yellow = in progress, green = finished)
note the quest-start map icon shown on the minimap/world map
go down the ladder into the Tutorial Island Dungeon
notes: Tutorial_Island.s7, Quest Guide. Dungeon map pin: {{Map|Tutorial Island mine|3096,9516|mapID=10159}} — shared location for both the Mining Instructor and Combat Instructor below.

atoms: talk to Dezzick, the Mining Instructor
receive a bronze pickaxe
mine the nearby copper rock -> copper ore (Mining xp)
mine the nearby tin rock -> tin ore (Mining xp)
use the furnace to smelt the copper ore + tin ore -> bronze bar (Smithing xp)
receive a hammer from Dezzick
use the hammer on the bronze bar at an anvil -> smith a bronze dagger (Smithing xp)
notes: Tutorial_Island.s7, Mining Instructor. Wiki explicitly calls out pushing both Mining and Smithing to level 3 here as worthwhile — almost nowhere else in the game has ore, a furnace, and an anvil this close together; the one caveat to speedrun-efficient play is that extra mining/smithing reps cost time the base route doesn't need.

atoms: talk to Vannaka, the Combat Instructor

notes: Tutorial_Island.s7, Combat Instructor/Melee. Health cannot reach 0 here (floors at 1) so eating is not required. A speedrun-efficient line kills the rat outright on first entry; the wiki also documents a 2-damage-then-retreat loop to farm extra melee xp by re-entering combat repeatedly (world-switching eventually needed to avoid accidental kills) — that loop is a deliberate detour, not part of the fastest line. Hitpoints cannot be trained on Tutorial Island.

atoms: talk to Vannaka again
receive a shortbow and 50 bronze arrows
equip the shortbow
attack and kill one giant rat with Ranged (melee re-entry to the pit is blocked at this point)

notes: Tutorial_Island.s7, Combat Instructor/Ranged + Controlling combat experience.

notes: Tutorial_Island.s14. The poll booth cannot actually be used to vote here — it requires a higher level than is obtainable on Tutorial Island (max total level 57). Tutorial Island bank tellers themselves cannot be talked to/traded with, unlike normal bank tellers.

notes: Tutorial_Island.s16, Prayer instructor. The organ upstairs in the chapel is playable but non-essential — skip it on a speedrun-efficient line.

notes: Tutorial_Island.s16, Ironman Mode. Mode is freely switchable while still on Tutorial Island; after leaving, Adam in Lumbridge only allows downward switches (Ultimate/Hardcore -> Standard -> non-Ironman), and the choice locks permanently after one week. '??': the wiki does not detail the Group Ironman branch's internal steps beyond noting Group Ironman players continue to The Node south of the final building instead of the Magic building.

talk to Terrova, the Magic Instructor
receive 5 air runes and 5 mind runes

notes: Tutorial_Island.s19. Only one guaranteed cast is allowed here before being told to move on; the wiki notes players can return to the rat pit to push Magic to level 3 (up to 32 of each rune needed, since xp is granted even on a miss) — an optional detour, not part of the fastest line.

atoms: talk to Terrova again
if planning Ironman Mode and it wasn't chosen yet, backtrack to the Ironman tutor first (he asks before you leave)
cast Lumbridge Home Teleport from the spellbook to leave Tutorial Island
notes: Tutorial_Island.s21, Leaving the island.

atoms: arrive in Lumbridge, north-east of Tutorial Island, with standard starting provisions
notes: Tutorial_Island.s21. Spawn point branches on the row-02 choice: inside/near the walled Lumbridge Castle if Adventure Paths was NOT unlocked (or Ironman Mode was chosen); outside the nearby pub near Adventurer Jon, who immediately introduces Adventure Paths, if it WAS unlocked and Ironman was not chosen. This closes step 0 (origin:tutorial) — mainland progression is a separate domain.

Closing aside, not part of the baseline route: an NPC named Skippy occasionally spawns in the starting house near the Gielinor Guide and can skip the entire tutorial outright. He is not permanently present (an anti-bot measure per the wiki), so this is a lucky bypass rather than a reliable speedrun-efficient line — the 23 rows above remain the grounded baseline. Trivia also confirms the island-wide caps referenced throughout this domain: max total level 57, max total xp 3334, both from Tutorial_Island.s24.

note: Exiting Tutorial Island: the Magic Instructor has the player cast Lumbridge Home Teleport (auto-taught spell, no Magic level or rune cost, ~30 min real-time cooldown) to leave. This lands the player in Lumbridge and permanently unlocks world chat and further skill training. Landing spot differs by whether the player unlocked the Adventure Paths task system from the Gielinor Guide at tutorial start: unlocked players spawn just outside The Sheared Ram pub near Adventurer Jon (who immediately explains Adventure Paths); players who skipped that system spawn inside/in front of Lumbridge Castle's walled courtyard instead. Ironman-mode players are diverted to a separate Ironman tutor before the teleport.

First gear stop is Lumbridge General Store (in the castle courtyard) -- non-GE named vendor, restocks on a per-item timer (sellmultiplier=1300/buymultiplier=400/delta=30). Stock relevant to the first hour: Spade (stock 5) is mandatory for X Marks the Spot and not obtainable free anywhere else nearby -- buy it here first. Shears (stock 2), Pot (stock 5), Bucket (stock 3) and Tinderbox (stock 2) are also sold here as backups, but Sheep Shearer/Cook's Assistant each hand out or spawn their own copies free during the quest (see origin:mainland:03/05), so buying those here is not required, only Spade is a hard gate.

Cook's Assistant (opener, ~1QP, Novice, Very Short): start by talking to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen (3208,3214). Needs egg + bucket of milk + pot of flour, all obtainable during the quest with zero GE use: bucket from the castle cellar + dairy cow in the Lumbridge cow field for milk; egg spawns at the chicken farm NW of the cow field; empty pot found near the Cook himself, then grain from outside Mill Lane Mill -> hopper+lever on the mill's top floor -> flour bin downstairs for pot of flour. Turn in to the Cook for 300 Cooking xp and permission to use the Cook-o-matic 100 range (reduced burn chance).

The Restless Ghost (opener, 1QP, Novice, Short): start by talking to Father Aereck in the chapel SE of Lumbridge Castle (3243,3210). Only real gate is being able to kill OR flee a combat level 13 skeleton -- the quick guide is explicit you don't have to kill it, just leave once you've searched the altar. Route: chapel -> hut west of Lumbridge Swamp (Father Urhney gives the Ghostspeak amulet free) -> graveyard mausoleum coffin (talk to ghost) -> Wizard's Tower basement (search altar for ghost's skull, skeleton spawns but is skippable) -> back to the coffin to finish. This is the longest-travel opener of the four because of the Wizard's Tower round trip. Reward: 1,125 Prayer xp + the Ghostspeak amulet, which the wiki notes to keep since later quests/content reuse it.

Sheep Shearer (opener, 1QP, Novice, Very Short): start by talking to Fred the Farmer at the sheep pen house north of Lumbridge Castle (3189,3273). If you don't already have 20 unnoted balls of wool, Fred gives you Shears free (no shop trip needed) -- shear sheep in the adjacent pen for 20 wool (rams and "The Thing" cannot be sheared, run out of the pen if one aggroes), then spin all 20 on the spinning wheel on Lumbridge Castle's 1st floor before returning to Fred. Reward: 150 Crafting xp, +50 bonus (200 total) if you spin the wool yourself instead of buying balls of wool outright, plus 60 coins -- the first guaranteed coin drop of the run.

X Marks the Spot (opener, 1QP, Novice, Very Short): start by talking to Veos in The Sheared Ram pub, Lumbridge (3228,3242). Needs a Spade (bought at Lumbridge General Store per origin:mainland:02 -- the Eastfloor spade does not work as a substitute). Four-dig route in order: (1) NW window of the small room attached to Bob's Brilliant Axes, Lumbridge; (2) behind Lumbridge Castle just outside the kitchen door; (3) NW of the Draynor Village jail near the wheat field/Leela, 4 tiles north of a bush -- located via a mysterious orb that reads Chebyshev distance to the treasure, same mechanic as Hot Cold clue trails; (4) the pig pen next to Martin the Master Gardener (Falador). Finish by using the ancient casket on Veos at the Port Sarim docks south of the Rusty Anchor Inn. Reward: 200 coins, an Antique lamp (300xp in any skill, reclaimable if lost), scroll box access + a free beginner scroll box, and +1 cap on every clue scroll tier -- this quest is also the first hour's only leg that pushes travel out to Draynor/Falador/Port Sarim.

First-hour travel budget is walking only. The one teleport every fresh account has is Lumbridge Home Teleport (auto-cast on tutorial exit, no Magic level/rune cost, ~30 min cooldown) which lands in the castle courtyard -- useful only as a return-to-Lumbridge reset, not for skipping travel elsewhere, since it's already the hub the player starts in. Every other Lumbridge transport option (amulet of glory, gnome glider, fairy ring DIS, ring of returning, canoe) needs an item, quest, or skill level the player doesn't have yet. The Al Kharid gate east of Lozar's house costs 10 coins each way to cross until Prince Ali Rescue is completed (avoidable via a long detour north of the Groats' farm) -- worth knowing as a coin sink to route around if coins are tight, though none of the four openers require crossing it.

Speedrun-efficient ordering for the four openers (own synthesis from each quest's Details/startmap + Lumbridge's Quests list, section 5.12/1): do Cook's Assistant and Sheep Shearer first since both start/finish inside or immediately around Lumbridge Castle (kitchen, cellar, cow field, mill, sheep pen, 1st-floor spinning wheel are all within ~10-30 tiles of the castle) -- zero long-distance travel, and both turn-ins can share a single castle visit. Do The Restless Ghost third: its only detour is the one-way Wizard's Tower basement trip, and it's cheap to slot in right after the castle work since the chapel/graveyard/swamp hut are all still Lumbridge-local, only the skull fetch leaves town. Do X Marks the Spot last: its dig route is the only opener that pushes travel out to Draynor Village and Falador before finishing at Port Sarim, so it doubles as the first venture into the wider Asgarnia/Kandarin road network the player will need for later quests, and its 200gp + free-skill lamp reward is a good capstone once the cheaper three are banked.

No Xerxes or DunkingOreos study notes exist under tools/wiki-kb/study/ (checked at task start: only BRIEFING.md, cows-chill.md, EXTRAPOLATION.md, faux.md, multiquest-im.md are present) -- those are YouTube speedrunners, not wiki pages, so wikicli-only discipline can't source them directly either. The wiki's own "Speedrunning" article is about the seasonal Speedrunning-worlds minigame/reward shop, not quest-ordering strategy, so it wasn't usable as an ordering source. This row's route synthesis (origin:mainland:08) is instead grounded directly in each quest's own Details/startmap coordinates and Lumbridge's own Quests/Buildings sections -- flagging so a future agent with real Xerxes/DunkingOreos notes can cross-check or override the ordering.

coords.label: Ardougne Rooftop Course start (climb Wooden Beams by the gem stall, SE marketplace corner, Agility 90+, stop failing at 95)

notes: Course choice and level gate VERIFIED correct: Ardougne Rooftop opens at 90 (matches this step's reqs.skills.agility:90). Ardougne facts (own words): 889 xp/lap, ~70,000 xp/hr max, 16-18.1 marks/hr base or 22/hr with the elite Ardougne Diary (25% reroll on failed spawns + 50% chance of a shortened 2-min cooldown). Hallowed Sepulchre is ALSO correctly named as an alternative -- per Agility_training's own table it offers much higher raw xp/hr at this level range (up to ~98,500-108,000 xp/hr, floor-dependent) plus loot (ring of endurance, hallowed marks), at the cost of requiring Sins of the Father and active, low-AFK play, whereas Ardougne is comparatively low-attention and doubles as the fastest source of marks of grace in the game -- the step's 'best XP and loot' framing is directionally accurate for Sepulchre but Ardougne is not simultaneously best-XP; recommend splitting the claim ('best for marks of grace' vs 'best for raw XP and loot') if step-label space allows. FLAG (xp bug, same systematic pattern): step's xp.agility=12862000 does not match either the cumulative-to-99 total (13,034,431) or the correct 90->99 delta (13,034,431-5,346,332=7,688,099, Experience_table.s2 exact) -- flag as unsourced/stale, correct delta is 7,688,099.

notes: Requirements: King's Ransom; Unlock: prayers Chivalry and Piety; How to start: talk to the Squire on the top floor of Camelot Castle. Page notes this lacks miniquest designation (listed as "Knight Waves Training Grounds", one-off unlock, not on Quest List).

notes: Requirements: None; Unlock: None (lore only); How to start: talk to either Fabia or Xilo in the Tlati Rainforest. Page notes this lacks miniquest designation (one-off lore content, not on Quest List).

notes: Requirements: The Feud, Rune Mysteries, Icthlarin's Little Helper; Unlock: Ali Morrisane's rune, blackjack, and clothing stores; How to start: speak to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid. Page notes this lacks miniquest designation (one-off unlock, not on Quest List).

unlocks: Ava's attractor (Ranged<50) or accumulator (Ranged>=50) - auto-collects ranged ammo
Ability to trade Ava for her devices
Ballistic attractor schematic if Pandemonium completed

notes: 4-stage fetch quest for Ava's device. Stage 1: talk to Ava, travel to undead chicken farm west of Ectofuntus, talk Alice/Malcolm loop, get crone-made amulet from old crone near Slayer Tower, give to Malcolm, buy 2 undead chickens w/ ecto-tokens. Stage 2: bring chickens + iron bars + hammer to Ava, get selected iron from Witch in manor, forge at Rimmington mine (face north), return magnet to Ava. Stage 3: cut undead tree (not dead tree) outside manor w/ mithril axe, see Turael in Burthorpe for Blessed axe (needs mithril axe + holy symbol), cut undead tree again for twigs, give to Ava, solve orb puzzle (toggle off all but 2nd/5th/9th left-to-right), combine solved notes + button + leather, hand in. Core reward is the Ava's device line feeding Ranged training.

items: Death rune and light source (obtainable in-quest)

unlocks: Watchtower Teleport (scroll)
Access to Gu'Tanoth ogre city and Ogre Enclave (blue dragon slaying spot)
5,000 coins
"Friend of the Ogres" ogre reputation

start.location: Watchtower north of Yanille, top floor via trellis (2546,3116, plane 2)

notes: Must be able to beat level-68 Gorad (safespottable) and run past level-111 blue dragons. Flow: talk to Wizard in tower, get fingernails from bush below, talk to Og NW of Yanille for Toban's key, rope across to Jangerberry island (talk Grew), enter Tunnel to Toban south of Gu'Tanoth, kill Gorad for tooth, give Toban dragon bones for relic part 3, loot chest, return relics to Wizard for ogre relic. Enter Gu'Tanoth, steal rock cake from market, pay 20 coins/talk guards to reach Skavid caves, get skavid map (death rune), solve 4-cave skavid word-repeat puzzle, gold bar unlocks east gate, second nightshade in Mad Skavid cave, use nightshade on Enclave guard to trigger cutscene. Brew magic ogre potion (guam unf + jangerberries + ground bat bones, in that order) with Wizard. Return to Enclave, potion 6 ogre shamans for crystal 3, mine Rock of Dalgroth for crystal 4, return all 4 crystals to correct pillar colors (NE magenta/SE grey/SW yellow/NW cyan), pull lever. Key spine value: unlocks Ogre Enclave blue dragons + Watchtower teleport infrastructure.

unlocks: Iban's staff + Iban Blast spell
Klank's gauntlets

notes: One-way point of no return dungeon crawl west of Ardougne toward Tirannwn. Talk King Lathas then Koftik at West Ardougne cave entrance, enter dungeon (no going back except via lever/rope pull). Light an arrow via Koftik's cloth+tinderbox, shoot the bridge guide-rope, cross grid maze carefully (keep HP>15), pull lever. Collect 4 light orbs (avoid wall traps, use plank on flat rocks, disarm trap on 4th), fuel furnace, descend well. Navigate slave-cage/pipe area (50 Thieving shortcut optional). Get unicorn horn via railing-on-boulder trick, kill 3 paladins (safespottable) for badges, use badges+horn on well to open door. Meet dwarves Niloof and Klank (get gauntlets - keep inv slot free), steal Witch's cat to enter her house for loot, kill 3 demons for amulets, brew dwarf beer + tinderbox on tomb. Kill Kalrag the spider (safespottable, ignores Protect Melee), get Iban's dove wearing Klank's gauntlets. Kill a Disciple of Iban for ceremonial robes (required to enter temple), use Doll of Iban on the well in Iban's temple (repeat through his attacks, ~8dmg unblockable spikes) to destroy him. Return to King Lathas via Koftik. Gates access to Tirannwn/Elf lands questline infrastructure.

unlocks: Lunar spellbook access
Lunar Isle + Lunar equipment shop
Astral Altar access
Seal of passage
50 astral runes
Me becomes a Nightmare Zone boss

notes: Long multi-stage quest gating the Lunar spellbook (key teleport/utility infrastructure). Get seal of passage from Brundt the Chieftain, sail to Lunar Isle with Captain Bentley (talk to 5 crew NPCs in strict order, then find 5 hidden symbols with a lit lantern around the ship). On Lunar Isle: kill Suqah (safespottable, lvl 111) for a tooth, brew a waking-sleep potion for Baba Yaga/Oneiromancer. Charge a Dramen staff at all 4 elemental altars (air/fire/water/earth, in order) to make a Lunar staff, hand to Oneiromancer. Mine+smelt lunar ore into a lunar helm; solve Pauline Polaris name-guess dialogue; kill more Suqah for a special tiara + 4 hides, tan hides, craft full lunar gear (torso/trousers/gloves/boots); dig up blue flowers west of the two bridges for the lunar ring; give the Oneiromancer all lunar gear then get it back. Enter the Dream World: light ceremonial brazier with waking-sleep-soaked kindling, then complete 6 mini-puzzles at colored platforms (dice-sum guessing, number-sequence pattern, 20-log chopping race, memorize-and-cross a Dream Puffs stepping-stone maze, hurdle race, copy-the-emote) before fighting and killing Me (level 79, safespottable, no gear switching allowed once in the dream, can't teleport out). Return via lectern to Lunar Isle, hand in seal of passage to Oneiromancer to finish.

items: Raw shark or raw manta ray or raw sea turtle
Lyre (drop from Lanzig/Borrokar/Lensa/Freidir, or craft with Fletching 25 + Woodcutting 40 + Crafting 40)

unlocks: Boat access to Miscellania, Etceteria, Neitiznot, Jatizso + Rellekka facilities
Wearable Fremennik blade + warrior/berserker/archer/farseer helms
Fossegrimen can enchant lyre into enchanted lyre (teleport item)
Free Jarvald travel to Waterbirth Island
Fremennik clan name

notes: Requires beating level-69 Draugen and an unarmed/unarmoured fight vs Koschei the deathless (first 3 forms; 4th form is safe to "die" to, even on HCIM). Order: lose a drinking contest to Manni, get Hunters' Talisman from Sigli, talk Olaf, obtain a lyre (craft from swaying-tree branch via Lalli's stew quest-within-quest, or farm Lanzig's 1/17 drop). Spin golden wool in Seers' Village if crafting the lyre, buy low-alcohol keg from Poison Salesman. Back in Rellekka: use beer on council workman for strange object, enchant lyre with raw fish at a strange altar near the bridge, hunt the Draugen via talisman, light strange object and use on longhall pipe, play enchanted lyre on stage, then win the rematch drinking contest vs Manni with the low-alcohol keg swap. Sigmund/Swensen trial is a long NPC-chase-and-recall-order chain culminating in paying Askeladden 5,000 coins then repeating the NPC list in reverse order. Thorvald trial: bank everything (no weapons/armour/runes allowed), craft a dramen/celastrus staff underground, fight Koschei's first 3 forms unarmed. Peer the Seer trial: bank all bankable items, solve a riddle (each line gives one letter of a 4-letter word) then a multi-step item-transformation puzzle (bucket/jug/vase/disks/red herring) to unlock a trapdoor exit. Finish by reporting to Brundt. High spine value: gates Fremennik Isles (Neitiznot/Jatizso/Miscellania/Etceteria) sea access.

unlocks: Antique lamp: 5,000 xp to any skill 50+
Knight Waves Training Grounds access
Chivalry prayer (needs Defence 60/70 Prayer via Knight Waves completion)
Piety prayer (same, via Knight Waves)

notes: Deep prerequisite quest chain (effectively requires Merlin's Crystal, Murder Mystery, Rune Mysteries, Druidic Ritual line too). Flow: at Sinclair Mansion, break in via smashed east window, grab scrap paper + address form + black knight helm from bookcase, give all 3 to guard then talk Gossip. Travel to Seers' Village courthouse for Anna's Trial: call Dog Handler (ask about poison), Butler (ask about dagger), Maid (ask about night of murder + thread) as witnesses via the Judge to get her declared not guilty. At Camelot Castle statue: cutscene, then free Merlin from his cell (reach vent, Telekinetic Grab a guard's hair clip or take a knight's lockpick, solve a 4-tumbler lock puzn - raise each tumbler until it shows green, keep raising the rest), climb to top floor and pick the round purple box. At Black Knights' Fortress (west of Edgeville): get an Animate rock scroll from Wizard Cromperty in Ardougne first, wear full black armour to enter through the south sturdy door, push the north wall, climb down, free King Arthur from his statue using granite, give him the bronze med helm + iron chainbody, then report to King Arthur at Camelot's round table to finish. Big spine value: unlocks Knight Waves -> Chivalry/Piety prayers, a broadly-used combat prayer tier.

items: 1 of each cut gem up to diamond (sapphire/emerald/ruby/diamond/opal/jade/red topaz)
Soul rune, mind rune, 2 law runes, earth rune

xp.choice: 30,000 xp x4 picks (any of Attack/Defence/Strength/Hitpoints/Prayer/Magic/Woodcutting/Crafting/Smithing/Herblore/Agility/Thieving, repeats allowed)

unlocks: Legends' Guild access + cape of legends shop
Ability to wield dragon square shield
Skills necklace / combat bracelet chargeable at Legends' Guild or Fountain of Rune
Kharazi Jungle access + 79 Agility vine shortcut
Replacement dark daggers from Radimus Erkle
Rune spear / Dragon spear / Shield left half added to Gem drop table
Nezikchened added to Nightmare Zone

notes: Master-difficulty capstone quest, one of the deepest prereq chains in the game (Family Crest, Heroes' Quest incl. Shield of Arrav/Lost City/Merlin's Crystal/Dragon Slayer I, Shilo Village line, Underground Pass line, Waterfall Quest, 107 QP). Must be able to beat a level-187 demon (Nezikchened, fought up to 3x). Flow: talk Radimus Erkle at the guild, travel to Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village, chop through and map all 3 jungle sections with Radimus notes, get bullroarer from a Jungle forester, summon Gujuo, crawl into Mossy rock cave (50 Agility). Smith a golden bowl (2 gold bars + hammer), have Gujuo enchant it (42+ Prayer, can fail), fill with sacred water from the pool, squeeze through a bookcase crevice, lockpick a gate, smash 3 boulders, force a 2nd gate (50 Str), place gems on carved rocks by color to open a marked wall (Soul/Mind/Earth/Law/Law rune order) and get the binding book. Douse Ungadulu's fire with the bowl, bind him with the book, fight and kill Nezikchened (prayer drained to 1/10 at fight start; ranged/melee+protect-melee recommended, he has high magic resist). Get Yommi tree seeds from Ungadulu, water them, brew a bravery potion (ardrigal + snake weed + vial water) for a branching "evil" (short, kill Viyeldi for a glowing dagger) or "good" (long, cast Holy Force on Zekin) path through a second cave to restore the water source, fighting 3 named skeletons (lvl 106/100/92) for crystal pieces either way. Grow+carve a Yommi totem from the restored tree, use on an old totem pole, survive 4 unavoidable melee hits (up to 72 dmg total, pray Protect Melee) while Nezikchened respawns after each of 3 skeletons, get gilded totem from Gujuo. Hand gilded totem + notes to Radimus at the guild, pick 4 skills for the 30k xp reward, finish. Very high spine value as a QP/skill-chain gate for later quests + the quest-cape line.

items: A second player "partner" from the opposite Shield of Arrav gang (Black Arm/Phoenix)
Ice gloves (obtainable in-quest) or smith's gloves(i)
Black full armour if Black Arm Gang member (non-trimmed)

unlocks: Heroes' Guild access
Dragon battleaxe + dragon mace purchase/wield
Fountain of Heroes (recharge amulet of glory)
Charge dragonstone jewellery scrolls
Fountain of Rune amulet-of-glory recharge grants 6 charges instead of 4

start.location: Entrance to Heroes' Guild, between Taverley and Burthorpe (2904,3511)

notes: Requires a second player as a partner from the OPPOSITE Shield of Arrav gang (Black Arm vs Phoenix) for a cooperative candlestick-theft sequence in Brimhaven - cannot be soloed. 3 independent fetch chains converge at Achietties: (1) Lava eel - get blamish snail slime from Gerrant in Port Sarim, mix into harralander(unf) for blamish oil, oil your fishing rod, travel to Taverley Dungeon (get dusty key from Velrak after killing the Jailer, or use 70 Agility shortcut, or 60 Sailing route via Charred Dungeon) and fish+cook one lava eel near the blue dragons. (2) Master thieves' armband - Black Arm partner talks Trobert in Brimhaven (password "Four leaved clover"), gets Miscellaneous key from Grip, passes it to Phoenix partner who navigates Brimhaven's food shop/secret wall panel (password "Gherkin" with Straven in Varrock) to lock Grip in a room; Black Arm partner then kills/traps Grip, loots 2 candlesticks from a chest, trades 1 to the Phoenix partner - each turns in a candlestick to their own gang leader (Katrine/Straven) for the armband. (3) Fire feather - get Ice Gloves by killing the level-111 Ice Queen inside White Wolf Mountain (ladder/tunnel maze north side), then travel to Entrana and kill the Firebird near the Law Altar for its feather. Hand in all three (eel, armband, feather) to Achietties. High spine value: hard-gates Legends' Quest and unlocks dragon weapon purchase infrastructure.

items: 2 full sets of H.A.M. robes (7 pieces each - drop chance boosted during quest)
Pickaxe (unless using games necklace post-Tears of Guthix)

unlocks: H.A.M. Store room access (loot chests: gems/jewellery/coins)
Water wheel tunnel access (Lumbridge Castle cellar <-> Dorgeshuun Mines <-> water wheel, free travel)
Bone dagger + Dorgeshuun crossbow special attacks
Dorgesh-Kaan city access
A free torch if you had no light source

notes: Must beat level-50 Sigmund with melee or magic. Follow Kazgar through hole under Lumbridge kitchen to Mistag, bring 2 sets of H.A.M. robes to Zanik in Lumbridge cellar (ironmen: pickpocket H.A.M. members instead, better odds during quest). Zanik follows you on a Lumbridge town tour (talk to Cook/Duke/Hans/random Man-or-Woman/Bob/Father Aereck/Lumbridge Guide/a goblin/shopkeeper) then infiltrate the H.A.M. Hideout in disguise (full robes), talk Johanhus, find a hidden trapdoor, and use a multi-step guard-sniping stealth sequence: position Zanik out of guard sightlines, lure each guard into her line of fire one at a time (4 guards total) using wait/say-now dialogue commands. notes: Talk to Prince Itzla Arkan at the Teomat, then again after the cutscene. Travel to Quetzacalli Gorge, rent the pub's basement room from the bartender for 30 coins, rest on the bed in the SE room, talk to the Prince, then ask the general store shopkeeper for help and return to talk to the Prince again in the room. Head north through the gate to the Tower of Ascension, talk to the Prince outside, chat with recruits Nova/Sergius/Felius/Caritta, talk to the Prince again (no pets following), then enter the tower and talk to Forebearer Janus to climb up. First Trial: pickpocket a caged Emissary Ascended for a tower key, loot two chests for a book/paper via a word-decode puzzle unique per player, read a resulting poem, and speak the derived passcode to Forebearer Janus on the same floor (don't go downstairs mid-trial or it resets). Second Trial: a wave-based combat encounter where you must heal Prince Itzla with bandages from medical boxes while fighting melee/mage waves. Third Trial: question every cultist and accuse whichever one mentions 'Mictl' (heretical, not part of Emissary beliefs). Final Trial: fight Prince Itzla himself (level ~unlisted) — pray melee against basics, re-enable prayer immediately after his sword-swipe special (which disables it), and run behind him when he telegraphs his AOE special; he's immune to special attacks (unequip a Scythe of Vitur and punch/kick instead). Loot Twilight Emissary robes from a chest, equip them, bring the Prince through the temple east, then descend into the ruins south into an Ice Dungeon: mine through rocks, pull 4 levers scattered through icy rooms while dodging Frost Nagua/frost crabs/traps (each trap deals 10 damage), then pull a chain for future shortcut access. Statue Puzzle: collect 3 coloured icons from urns (level-104 Frost Nagua spawn continuously, Protect from Magic negates their hits), fix broken statues with the icons, then read corner murals to learn a player-specific activation order (Zema/Oma/Yeya/Naui = 1-4) and touch statues in that order to open the frozen door. Final Boss: fight Amoxliatl (level 263) praying magic, avoiding ice pools/spikes, re-enabling Protect from Magic after it's disabled, and meleeing the healing ice blocks she summons (or ignoring them at high level and just maging her). Finish by speaking to Servius, Teokan of Ralos, at the Sunrise Palace.

notes: Talk to Irena south of Shantay Pass to start. At the Desert Mining Camp entrance, goad the Mercenary Captain (level 47, safespottable/cannonable) into attacking via dialogue and kill him for the gate key — do not skip the dialogue or enter without full waterskins, both can get you jailed or killed by heat damage. Unequip all weapons/armour before entering the gate (graceful is fine if not worn over the required desert clothing) — equipping gear or removing the disguise inside gets you jailed. Trade with the male slave on the east wall for slave clothes when no guard is watching (getting caught = jail; escape by bending the window bars, climbing out over the wall/cliff, and re-entering the gate), equip the clothes, and enter the mine north. Follow the path to a guarded cave entrance and talk to a guard until he mentions a Tenti pineapple, then leave the mine, fully unequip the slave robes, and exit camp via the front gate (or fairy ring BIQ) — leaving in disguise through either the gate or the mine door also risks jail. At Bedabin Camp (west of the mining camp) talk to Al Shabim in the south tent for a Bedabin key. Back in the mining camp (slave outfit on again), climb to the jail building's upper floor, search the southernmost west-wall bookcase for a sailing-books clue, then talk to Captain Siad in the same room and open a chest for technical plans. Show the plans to Al Shabim, then use the northern tent's anvil to smith a bronze dart tip from a bar and fletch it with 10 feathers into a prototype dart; trade it to Al Shabim for the Tenti pineapple. Re-suit in slave clothes, give the pineapple to a mine guard, head east past a mine cart, search barrels for a spare barrel, then search the mine cart to trigger a cutscene ride (redo if it doesn't trigger). Do not talk to Ana — instead follow the west-north-west path and use the spare barrel on her (don't try to teleport with her in your inventory, it drops the barrel). Ride the cart back, put Ana in it then get in yourself, search barrels to find her again, place her on the north-west winch bucket, decline the guard's suspicion-raising offer of help, then surface, operate the winch (south-west of camp), search the barrel west of the winch for Ana, load her onto the wooden cart at camp centre, and talk your way past the mine cart driver. Elder Blunn then gives a Tortugan shield (cape slot, must stay equipped) before sailing to The Little Pearl to fight the level-235 Shellbane Gryphon — use Protect from Melee/Ranged, ranged/magic negates a mechanic, its charge knockback (up to 65 dmg) is blocked by standing near a tree/eggs, step off tiles when whirlwinds spawn on wing-flap warning. After the fight, talk to Korel about a mysterious ship before returning to Elder Raley to finish.

Elite black armour and Dark Squall's robes
Access to the Black Knight Catacombs
Adoptable broav pet if kept

notes: Grandmaster Mahjarrat-storyline quest, sequel to Defender of Varrock, chasing the Stone of Jas. Thaerisk sends you to kill 2 assassins, then investigate Movario at the Fight Arena: bribe/charm the Khazard Launderer for info, train a broav at Feldip Hills to sniff out Movario's hideout, then break into his underground base solving a rune-symbol door puzzle, a bookcase-lever/wire maze, a trapped bed chest, and a weight/pressure-gauge puzzle to recover two volumes of notes. Rally allies: rescue Idria from mercenaries at McGrubor's Wood, plant a teleorb on a shady stranger near Draynor for Akrisae, get a snapdragon seed from Thaerisk and enrich it with pink dye + Betty's help, plant it at Falador castle. Use NPC Contact to summon Turael/Mazchna/Cyrisus/Duradel about Lucien, harvest the enriched snapdragon for a truth serum to interrogate a captured shady stranger, then recruit Ghommal/Harrallak/Sloane at the Warriors' Guild. Infiltrate Black Knights' Fortress in disguise, descend into the Black Knight Catacombs, farm elite black armour off Elite Black Knights, rescue Silif and swap armour with him, then face Surok Magis (magic-only, 450hp, Vorkath-style attack rotation: bind/weaken his summoned warriors, telegrab-and-alch his explosive orbs, counter his elemental surges with the opposite element) atop the fortress. Teleport to Lucien's camp via a strange teleorb, then descend the Chasm of Tears: collect 4 elemental orbs from braziers, solve elemental-block puzzles inside skull tunnels, and match herblore-ingredient offerings to 8 of 13 statues (offerings vary per player) to open the final door. Finish with the Balance Elemental (524, prayer-switches by its attack style, drains stats every 3-4 hits, doubles up at 25% hp) then two Tormented Demons alongside the Guardians of Armadyl (can be cheesed by letting the Guardians finish them off from behind a pillar) before returning to Idria to complete.

notes: A boy's ball landed in a scary witch's garden. Sneak into her house (key under the potted plant by the front door), grab gloves and a magnet from the basement, then trap a mouse with cheese and the magnet. Cross the garden to the fountain and shed without the Witch seeing you (stick to hedges, never walk on grass, or you must repeat the break-in); getting caught mid-fight also drops your combat stats if you grab the ball too early. Open the shed and fight the Witch's experiment through all four escalating forms (levels 19/30/42/53, corners of the shed are safespottable), take the ball, then sneak/teleport back out and return it to the boy.

start.location: Hetty's house in Rimmington, south of Falador and west of Port Sarim (2967,3205)

notes: Hetty the witch wants help brewing a potion. Gather four ingredients: kill a rat in the archery shop west of Hetty for a rat's tail, buy an eye of newt from Betty (3gp), kill a giant rat at the chapel south of Port Sarim for raw rat meat and burn it on Hetty's fireplace, and pick an onion from the field north of Rimmington. Bring all four to Hetty and drink from her cauldron to finish.

Head to Yanille, use the recovered Dragon Inn tankard on the bartender there, then visit Zavistic Rarve at the Wizards' Guild. Investigate the ogres' bedridden neighbor Sithik Ints: search his room for a portraiture book, necromancy book, papyrus/charcoal and a Book of 'H.A.M.', read and use all three on him, then sketch a portrait that reads as an honest "classic realist charcoal portrait" (higher Crafting speeds this up) and get it signed by the Dragon Inn bartender. Bring the necromancy book, H.A.M. book, tankard and signed portrait to Zavistic Rarve for a strange potion; spike Sithik's tea with it, then question him for the secrets to Relicym's balm, curing the disease, and removing the undead ogres. Return to Grish for an ogre gate key and to learn comp ogre bow use, then fight the level-111 Slash Bash (uses Ranged+Melee — safespot with Protect from Missiles, or use Crumble Undead) in the ceremonial chamber to finish.

unlocks: The book of the dead
Two antique lamps (10,000 xp each to any skill level 40+, only one if the Architectural Alliance lamp was already claimed before 10 Jan 2024)
Ability to set respawn point to Kourend Castle (via Asteros Arceuus)

notes: Investigate the disgraced Councillor Sophia Hughes' escape for Commander Fullore and Martin Holt. Search a house for a receipt, question Tomas Lawry and the Lovakengj pub owner Fuggy, then a cutscene at Veos's boat in Port Piscarilius drops you straight into a fight with the level-168 demon Judge of Yama (dodge fire waves like Galvek, melee him in the gaps, he prays overhead the whole fight). Pickpocket Istoria and search a case in the Arceuus Library for Rose's diary and a hidden note, then chase Rose's trail: solve a stone-pile numeric code at the Forthos Ruins, fight off an assassin and melt an ice panel with a fire spell at the Settlement Ruins, and match statue-panel order at The Legless Faun in Piscarilius, ending at a shack trapdoor near the Farming Guild. Head into Molch's Lizard dwelling to see Khat B'alam, retrieve a lizardman egg from Kebos Swamp (a level-75 lizardman brute attacks but doesn't need to be killed) to trade for a key, then fight the spirit boss Xamphur (239, Protect from Magic, kill summoned hands, dodge falling-hand mechanic Vorkath-style). Visit all five Kourend house Lords/Ladies at their home locations, then again at Xeric's Lookout to gather their support. Finish by brewing a sulphur potion (defence potion + volcanic sulphur) enchanted by Kaal-Mej-San at Mount Karuulm into a shielding potion for the Doors of Dinh, defeat a level-91 Barbarian Warlord in the Kourend Woodland, collect a declaration from Jorra in the Graveyard of Heroes (kill a level-132 assassin), craft a dark essence block (pickaxe+chisel a dense runestone near the Dark Altar, use on the Dark Altar) to trade Mori for a dark nullifier, retrieve a Shayzien journal from a lockpicked chest in the Hosidius Vinery, then report back to all five Lords and Commander Fullore at Xeric's Lookout for the final cutscenes.

notes: The Mysterious Stranger wants Lady Verzik Vitur humiliated. Visit Atza near the southern gate of Civitas illa Fortis, set up a pile of equipment (hammer available nearby) for her, and receive trimmed fur in return. Return the trimmed fur/report to Fox, deliver his report to Guild Scribe Verity, fix Kiko's cat bed with the spare jerboa tail, and report to Guildmaster Apatura to finish. No combat required.

Search Kaleef's corpse, read the parchment, then shuttle between Maisa (west) and Osman (Al Kharid, then Sophanem's gates) to arrange a second, secret entrance. Re-enter via that route and kill the level-191 Giant Scarab boss (safespottable near Kaleef's body with Protect from Missiles if maging/ranging, but it can spawn mages/riders and extinguishes bullseye lanterns -- bring a tinderbox). Talk to Osman, optionally grab Keris for the Desert hard diary (don't teleport out if going for that task; return and kill a locust rider with it), then return to the High Priest to finish. Butler's tray + assortment of masks (from the Head Butler)
North Aldarin teleport destination via pendant of ates

notes: Murder-mystery on the island of Aldarin. Break into the house north of Patzi via the south window (wait for the guard to move) to steal a servant uniform, then wear it to enter Villa Lucens through the Head Butler (who holds your gear). Talk to the four nobles (Constantinius, Cozyac, Pavo, Xocotla) and Patzi, then search the wine cellar for clues (antique wine, injured man, jugs, box, stool, pottery, Livius' body, wine storage). Talk to guards Stradius/Hutza, pickpocket all six suspects, inspect the physical evidence (wine labels, threatening note, shipping contract, drinking flask), then accuse and fight Adala (level 49) -- she's innocent. Climb the Loose rocks shortcut, go backstage, question the Costumer, search the poisoned crate/secret bookshelf passage/stained costume rack, then accuse and fight Naiatli on stage to close the case. Post-quest: claim masks/tray from the Head Butler, needle from the Costumer, pickpocket Constantinius for a chest key (opens the cellar's fancy chest), search the SW fountain for an icon, and use it on the NE Aldarin statue for a bonus reward.

notes: Grandmaster capstone: the Ancient Vault hub has 4 empty statues, one per medallion looted from the 'Forgotten Four' bosses guarding fragments of the fallen Empty Lord's empire. Familiar Faces: solve a mural/mining intro at the Digsite then kill the Ancient Guardian (shield regens unless meleed; dodge falling rocks by avoiding shadowed tiles) and solve a totem/cell golem puzzle. Vardorvis: sail to the Stranglewood, defend Kasonde from strangled for 3 minutes with barricades/satchels, brew a strangler serum from gathered herbs, kill Vardorvis (slash weapon, dodge axes/root splats/prayer-disabling darts) then Kasonde himself (ranged/kite, avoid poison splats, out-DPS his healing). Perseriya: through Guardians of the Rift's Scar, solve 3 randomized puzzle rooms (nerve-combination circuits, cerebral-orb maze, rune-nerve crafting) to burn 3 ships, then fight the Leviathan with Ranged+Shadow spells (prayer-switch by attack colour, stun and hit its back). Duke Sucellus: escape a prison cell, solve gate-code puzzles (chest passwords/combinations) while dodging Jhallan, then defeat the sleeping Duke via a mushroom-poison mechanic and dodge his ice-spike/acid/eye-gaze attacks behind pillars. The Whisperer: navigate the Shadow Realm of Lassar's undercity collecting shadow-torch schematics and keys while managing a sanity meter, then fight a magic-weak boss with frequent prayer switches. After all 4 medallions are placed, the finale ("The Desert Treasure") has you fight a Mysterious Figure, then Sliske's four wights one after another (Forsaken Assassin, Ketla the Unworthy, Kasonde the Craven, Persten the Deceitful -- each with distinct dodge mechanics) before a final cutscene with Azzanadra.

notes: Grandmaster sequel to Dragon Slayer I; also requires having started the pyre-ship part of the Barbarian Training miniquest for Ancient Cavern access. Investigate a mural under Crandor, then find and solve a 24-piece jigsaw map on Fossil Island, build a rowboat to Lithkren, and read a skeleton's diary. Use a Catspeak amulet to find Bob the Cat and have the Sphinx enchant permanent cat-speech. On Lunar Isle, brew a dream potion and fight Robert the Strong inside Bob's dream (melee/crush-only fight, hide behind pillars to dodge his special). Collect 4 dragon key pieces: Karamja (navigate a trapped jungle-temple maze avoiding golem melee/ranged/magic by colour), Morytania (craft a locator orb and dowse for a buried piece in Mort Myre Swamp), Ungael (kill Vorkath, then solve a lever/timed-run dungeon puzzle), Kourend (statue-placement riddle in a skeleton-filled crypt). Reforge the key at the Ancient Cavern by casting Fire Wave/Surge on 3 dragon heads, then open the Lithkren doors. Rally Varrock/Falador/Ardougne (or Kandarin) rulers for 'A World United', then 'The Assault': defend a ship from a boarding raid, fight through checkpointed waves of increasingly dangerous dragons (green/blue, then black/steel/brutal red, then mithril/adamant/rune -- the last two have hazardous specials needing antidote++/insulated boots), and finish with a 4-phase Galvek fight requiring full dragonfire protection and phase-specific dodges (fire traps, stat-drain beam, wave-gaps, earth-bind projectiles).

unlocks: 5,000 coins

notes: Investigate a theft from the Fortis Grand Museum. Inspect the empty display case, talk to Curator Herminius, then question museum visitors until one mentions a suspicious man. Follow the trail: Regulus Cento by the quetzals, then a Trader Crewmember (do Artima a sail-repair favour first to get his help), then Trader Stan/crew at Port Sarim, then Betty at the Port Sarim rune shop for a note. Head to Varrock Museum, ask Curator Haig Halen about Xerna's Diadem, pickpocket him for the storeroom key, search the crates in the NE storeroom, then confront and shame Haig Halen with the correct dialogue picks (the in-depth guide lists the exact options). Return to Herminius at the Fortis museum to close the case.

items: Combat gear for multiple PvM encounters

Lesser nagua Slayer task assignment

notes: The dwarven town Cam Torum's underground temple Neypotzli has stirred 3 sealed ancient bosses. Kill a Sulphur Nagua guarding the entrance, enter the city, and meet Jessamine, Attala, Zuma. Build 3 camps in the dungeon's corner areas (Ancient Prison, Streambound Cavern, Earthbound Cavern) using building supplies. Get water and earth talismans from Attala, have them infused (magic shop's Nahta, then the blacksmith), then dowse hot/cold with both talismans to locate the hidden NPC Eyatlalli (location varies per player). Gather 3 ritual items around the dungeon (moonlight grub paste, bream scales from fishing, a trapped moss lizard's tail) and start the ritual. Fight all 3 Moons of Peril in their own chambers: Blue Moon (crush-weak; weapon-freeze and brazier-relight specials), Blood Moon (slash-weak; raining-blood pools and blood-jaguar specials), Eclipse Moon (stab-weak; rotating shield and clone-facing specials) -- stand in a rotating safe-damage circle throughout, damage during specials still counts. Return to the Antechamber and speak to Eyatlalli to finish.

items: Lockpick (the Strange Old Lockpick does NOT work)

Access to a stronger version of the Strange Creature: the Phantom Muspah

notes: Also needs Desert Treasure I started (for the ring of visibility) though not a full completion requirement. Murder-mystery continuing the Hazeel Cult/General's Shadow storyline. Investigate Ceril's murder at Carnillean Mansion (broken window, hidden room behind a false wall), then track and fight Evelot (level 148, drains prayer on her specials) near the Fight Arena bar by following a clue trail. Visit the Hazeel Cult hideout via an Ardougne sewers raft to enlist Hazeel's help, lockpick a hidden chest behind the mansion's cooking shelves for a scroll. Travel to Weiss, question Big Fish and Snowflake, then fight a level-262 Assassin (lures you with smoke bombs, throws poison vials). Solve a multi-stage code-lock dungeon under Weiss (a 'BLOOD' gate code, a chest code, a brazier-lighting order, an arrow-direction gate code, combining two jewel shards) to reach the final boss, the Strange Creature -- resupply with ranged/magic gear first. Return to the mansion guard to finish; unlocks the Phantom Muspah boss.

Follow red marks west to the river, fish cloth from a floating plank, then follow a trail of puddles around the mountain to a cave holding an injured boy. Bring 4 willow longbows to Captain Ariadna and reinforce the house's west wall with 4 maple logs + a hammer, then talk to the now-rescued kids upstairs. Return to the cave, talk to Antos, and fight 3 Strange Creatures (level 93 -- their bleed still ticks through Protect from Melee). Report back to Captain Ariadna to finish and unlock the Stalker Den.

Runes for Lvl-3 Enchant (1 cosmic + 5 fire) or an enchant ruby/topaz tablet

grants.effect: 492 tasks spread across 12 regions x 4 tiers (Easy/Medium/Hard/Elite). A tier's rewards can only be claimed from that diary's own taskmaster once every task in that tier AND every preceding tier of the same region is complete (tasks themselves can be done out of order). Every tier claim always includes an antique lamp + an equippable armour/cape piece, plus passive perks: xp-rate boosts, shop discounts, new teleport unlocks, and region access. Completing every diary at every tier unlocks purchase of the achievement diary cape (99,000gp, Twiggy O'Korn, Draynor Village), which itself lets the quest point cape be trimmed cyan and is one of two requirements for the music cape's black trim.

notes: Own words, system-level rather than per-region: this is the requester's own named steer-point pattern (CONSOLIDATED.md pattern 12, 'QP/diary as progression metric & anchor') so it is marked hard rather than soft. Concretely non-obvious hard-gate found in this pass: the aggregate 'All requirements' tables (Achievement_Diary.s2, one per tier via a shared DiarySkillStats+quest-list tabber) list 'Acquire a prospector helmet from the Motherlode Mine' as an Additional-requirement checkbox for BOTH the Hard tier AND the Elite tier bundles (i.e. across every region's Hard/Elite diary, not one specific region) -- only ONE prospector helmet piece is needed to satisfy this box, not the full 4-piece set, but it means the Prospector kit unlock (unlockdb:prospector-kit, this same batch) is a literal cross-dependency baked into the diary system, not just a coincidentally-useful item. Other Hard/Elite aggregate gates worth flagging for planner interleaving: Warriors' Guild access (130 combined Attack+Strength or 99 in either), Wilderness God Wars Dungeon access, at least one god spell, and (Elite only) full completion of Chambers of Xeric, TzHaar Fight Cave, and 'all quests' -- these functionally chain the diary system to the raid/quest-cape burndown too.

items: Fishing Trawler minigame drop (1/12 chance per game of a NOT-yet-owned piece, contribution bar must be >=50 when the game ends; average ~48 games / ~4h48m for the full set), OR purchase from Alry the Angler for 100 Molch pearls per piece (400 total) via aerial fishing -- explicitly the slower, not-recommended path (20+ hours)

grants.effect: Full set: +2.5% Fishing xp on all Fishing activities (does not apply to drift net fishing or deep sea trawling). More importantly the outfit is a hard functional requirement, not just an xp multiplier, for three separate things: a master clue step, the 'Dress Like You Mean It' hard combat achievement, and access to minnow fishing.

notes: Own words: upgradeable to the spirit angler's outfit by trading each piece + 1,200 spirit flakes (4,800 total) to Gita Prymes in the Ruins of Unkah, which lets the outfit double as a tether rope when fighting Tempoross. Time-investment section on the source page explicitly warns the outfit is NOT worth farming purely for the xp bonus against faster training methods (3-tick barbarian fishing at 65, 3-tick fly fishing/Tempoross-with-crystal-harpoon at 80) -- own-words break-even is only worthwhile below ~66,129 xp/hr. Marked hard rather than soft specifically because of the minnow-fishing/clue-step/combat-achievement functional gates, which cannot be bypassed by training rate the way the xp bonus can.

notes: Own words: reward is claimed automatically on finishing the 10th (final) Easy Ardougne Diary task, no separate NPC turn-in. Not a hard gate for anything else in the KB, but a high-leverage soft accelerant already cross-referenced by two other contributed rows: bg:pps-03-withdraw-herb-run cites the cloak as the closest teleport to the Ardougne herb patch (2667,3375), and Spirit_tree.s1's own text calls Ardougne cloak -> Ardougne Monastery -> Khazard Battlefield spirit tree (immediately NW) the cheapest, lowest-requirement route into the spirit-tree network before 83 Farming makes the Farming Guild tree reachable. Also grants (bundled Easy-diary rewards, not cloak-specific): one antique lamp worth 2,500xp in any skill 30+, and double death runes + auto-noted Jubster/Frogeel drops when trading cats to West Ardougne civilians.

quests: Fairytale II - Cure a Queen (partial, up to 'granted permission')
items: Dramen staff or Lunar staff to activate a ring (waived if the player has completed the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary)

grants.effect: Unlocks the fairy ring transportation network: 55 of 64 possible A/B/C/D letter-code combinations are active landing points spread across almost every region of the game, each reached by dialling a 3-letter code at any ring. This is the single densest point-to-point travel web in the game and is treated as the default transport layer in nearly every other route/guide already mined into this KB (herb-patch runs, Chambers of Xeric access, Barrows, Mort Myre, penguin/Miscellania errands).

notes: Own words: the unlock is a quest-chain burndown in itself (5 quests + a partial 6th), not a single flag, so it should be modelled as its own multi-quest requisite node rather than folded silently into whichever quest happens to finish it. Once live it becomes a hard dependency for a large share of downstream travel steps already contributed elsewhere in this KB (travel:ref-fairy-ring, bg:pps-03-withdraw-herb-run, travel:milestone-raids-cox all cite fairy-ring codes as a named routing option) -- it is the earliest 'hard' access anchor a fresh account can reach, and most later route synthesis assumes it is already unlocked. Downstream acceleration: turns multi-region herb runs, raid access, and quest-hub travel from multi-minute walks/teleport-chains into a single 2-click ring dial.

items: 260 marks of grace (hood 35, top 55, legs 60, gloves 30, boots 40, cape 40), bought piece by piece from Grace at the Rogues' Den

grants.effect: Full set: -25kg weight and +30% run-energy restoration rate. No skill/quest hard-gate to purchase -- only the mark-of-grace currency, earned by running rooftop Agility courses (best rate at Canifis, level 40, 16-18/hr with no level-over-20 penalty; Ardougne, level 90, reaches 22/hr with the elite Ardougne diary).

notes: Own words: pure QoL multiplier, nothing else in the KB treats it as a hard prerequisite, but it compounds efficiency across virtually every later travel/training step that involves running (less need for stamina potions, more inventory space free of energy items). Distinct from a separate, cheaper action: RECOLOURING an already-owned full set costs only 90 marks total (or 15/piece) paid to Osten in Shayzien, not the 260-mark Grace purchase -- do not conflate the two costs. Sell-back refund on uncoloured pieces to Grace is 80% (208 marks).

grants.effect: Each of the 5 short Kourend quests adds one torn page to the memoirs, each page unlocking a 'Reminisce' teleport to its own city plus 20 teleport charges (stacking with further pages); cannot teleport past level 20 Wilderness. After A Kingdom Divided the book auto-upgrades to the Book of the dead (reclaimed from Commander Fullore instead of Veos), which per an existing KB row (travel:milestone-raids-cox) also sets up a two-way transport to Shayziens' Wall from the Chambers of Xeric mountain via the Mountain Guide.

notes: Own words: marked inline rather than hard/soft because none of the 5 gating quests exist solely to earn a memoirs page -- all 5 (Depths of Despair, Queen of Thieves, Tale of the Righteous, Forsaken Tower, Ascent of Arceuus) are ALSO direct quest requirements already contributed elsewhere for the Kourend & Kebos Medium diary and for A Kingdom Divided (questdb: rows confirm this), so the teleport network accrues automatically as a side effect of doing those quests for other reasons -- no dedicated grind/step needs scheduling for it. The book itself is a quest-item reward of Client of Kourend, reclaimable free from Veos (or Cabin Boy Herbert post-partial A Kingdom Divided) if lost, and retains charges through a destroy/reclaim cycle.

items: 1,000 coins paid to any estate agent (default path), OR free automatically on completing the Daddy's Home miniquest (10 planks + 5 bolts of cloth + 16+ nails + a hammer/saw, all obtainable in-quest)

grants.effect: Grants a personal, expandable house (Rimmington by default, relocatable to 8 cities for a fee at higher Construction) that is the entire focus of the Construction skill and doubles as the best travel hub in the game once built out: a portal chamber/nexus can hold teleports from every spellbook at once (no spellbook-switching needed), a fully-upgraded jewellery box gives unlimited ring of dueling/games necklace/skills necklace/combat bracelet/amulet of glory/ring of wealth teleports, and the 75-Construction superior garden's spirit-tree-and-fairy-ring hotspot is the single fastest access point to BOTH transport networks at once from one tile.

notes: Own words: also unlocks the ability to use experience lamps on Construction and to earn Construction xp from repairing Wintertodt braziers / Tempoross totem poles+masts / Vale Totem poles -- i.e. owning a POH is a hard prerequisite for gaining Construction xp from three separate group minigames, not just a nice-to-have room. Treated as a hard anchor because so much later infrastructure (occult altar spellbook-swap, gilded altar prayer training at 3.5x with both incense burners lit, costume room bank-space relief, mounted glory in the quest hall) is gated behind first getting the house at all, and several already-contributed KB rows (Daddy's Home reward text, herb-run teleport-choice notes) already assume a POH exists. Downstream acceleration: the free-via-Daddy's-Home path means a fresh account never needs to pay the 1,000gp if that short miniquest is slotted early.

items: Golden nuggets from the Motherlode Mine, spent at Prospector Percy's shop: helmet 40, jacket 60, legs 50, boots 30 (180 total for the full set; 30 Mining to enter/mine in the Motherlode Mine itself)

grants.effect: Mining xp boost per piece: helmet +0.4%, jacket +0.8%, legs +0.6%, boots +0.2%, plus a +0.5% set bonus for wearing all 4, totalling +2.5% Mining xp on the full set. Prospector armour does not increase golden-nugget drop chance itself. Buying the pricier pieces first is marginally more xp-efficient overall.

notes: Own words, non-obvious cross-dependency found this pass: the Achievement Diary system's own aggregate 'All requirements' tables (Achievement_Diary.s2) list 'Acquire a prospector helmet from the Motherlode Mine' as an Additional-requirement checkbox for BOTH the Hard tier AND Elite tier bundles across every region's diary -- only the helmet piece is needed to satisfy this, not the full 4-piece set, but it makes prospector kit a literal hard prerequisite baked into unlockdb:achievement-diary-system rather than a standalone cosmetic-xp buy. Marked hard on that basis even though the xp-boost effect alone would only justify soft.

quests: All quests (every released quest, miniquests excluded)
items: 99,000 coins, paid to the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village (also buys the matching quest point hood)

grants.effect: Unlimited teleport to the Legends' Guild gates -- the second-closest teleport to a fairy ring after a POH. Independent of whether the cape is worn, players holding max quest points also get every Nightmare Zone dream discounted 10,000 coins. Performing the cape's emote is itself a required task for the Elite Lumbridge & Draynor Diary (in the Wise Old Man's house) and the Elite Falador Diary (atop Falador Castle).

notes: Own words: this is the requester's own named capstone/checkpoint pattern (CONSOLIDATED.md pattern 12, QP as a progression anchor) and it directly cross-links to unlockdb:achievement-diary-system via the two elite-diary emote tasks above -- i.e. the quest cape and the diary system gate each other at the elite tier. If a new quest releases after the cape is obtained, it auto-unequips and cannot be re-equipped/operated until the new quest is completed (banked automatically if inventory is full; LOST and must be re-bought for 99,000gp if both inventory and bank are full when this happens) -- a real risk worth flagging for any planner treating 'quest cape obtained' as a terminal, static state rather than one that can regress on future quest releases. Trimming the cape (cyan) additionally requires the achievement diary cape (all diaries at all tiers), chaining this unlock to unlockdb:achievement-diary-system a second way.

items: Rogue's equipment crates from successfully opening wall safes at the end of the Rogues' Den minigame (untradeable pieces, so 50 Agility + 50 Thieving are effectively required just to wear them even though the minigame itself has no stated level gate on the page fetched)

grants.effect: Doubles pickpocketing loot: each of the 5 pieces (mask/top/gloves/trousers/boots) adds a flat +15% chance to double an NPC's pickpocket loot (15/30/45/60% for 1-4 pieces), and wearing all 5 together jumps straight to a guaranteed 100% -- not a linear extrapolation of the per-piece rate. Pieces are interchangeable (any 5 of the 5 slots filled = 100%, doesn't matter which). Does not affect chests, stalls, Pyramid Plunder, Hallowed Sepulchre, Underwater Agility and Thieving, or scroll-box drop rates; coin pouches/scroll boxes get a different doubling mechanic (chance at one extra pouch/coin value instead of a flat double).

notes: Own words: narrow QoL multiplier scoped entirely to pickpocket-based Thieving training/money-making, doesn't gate anything else in the KB. Storable in a POH costume room armour case (cross-references unlockdb:player-owned-house). Since 1 June 2017 the crates let players pick which piece to receive (previously fixed order until full set owned), which matters for Ultimate Ironmen who can no longer be RNG-locked out of the full set.

grants.effect: Unlocks the spirit-tree transportation network: 8 permanent stops (Tree Gnome Village, Tree Gnome Stronghold, Battlefield of Khazard, Grand Exchange, Feldip Hills, Poison Waste (partial Path of Glouphrie), Prifddinas (Song of the Elves), Laguna Aurorae (Pandemonium+58 Sailing)) plus 5 Farming-grown patches and a POH superior-garden tree at 75 Construction.

notes: Own words: gate is a single, cheap early quest (Tree Gnome Village, confirmed on Unlockable_content.s18's own table) versus fairy rings' 5-quest chain -- this makes spirit tree the FIRST regional teleport-web a fresh account can unlock, not merely a lesser alternative. It is not a hard dependency for anything else in the KB (nothing greps as requiring spirit-tree access), so it reads as a soft/optional accelerant, but a high-value one: source page's own text ranks fastest-access methods pre-83-Farming as Ardougne cloak -> Khazard Battlefield tree (zero cost, low reqs) or GE (ring of wealth/teletab + medium Varrock Diary), and calls the Achievement Diary Cape + Elder Gnome child route faster than even the POH tree despite being farther on foot (no POH load screen). Downstream acceleration: bridges the travel gap between tutorial-exit and the fairy-ring unlock chain being finished.

items: No purchase/quest gate on the amulet itself -- it is a monster drop: 1/250 from lizardmen/lizardman brutes/lizardman shamans (improved to 1/125 after the easy Kourend & Kebos Diary), or 1/300 stealing from stone chests in the Lizardman Temple beneath Molch

grants.effect: 4 free teleports by default (Xeric's Lookout SE of Shayzien, Xeric's Glade NE of the Hosidius farm patch, Xeric's Inferno at the Lovakengj lovakite furnace, Xeric's Heart at Kourend Castle) plus a 5th, Xeric's Honour at the Chambers of Xeric summit on Mount Quidamortem, which permanently unlocks only after using an Ancient tablet (a 1/10 drop from the post-raid Ancient chest) on the talisman.

notes: Own words: no quest/skill gate to obtain the base item, only RNG (or the diary-boosted RNG); reaching a lizardman spawn to farm it does benefit from prior Kourend region quests for fast travel but that is convenience, not a hard requirement. Cross-references existing KB row travel:milestone-raids-cox, which already lists 'xerics-talisman-post-first-clear' as one of three named routes into Chambers of Xeric, and diarydb:kourend-and-kebos-hard, whose own Hard-tier task list includes 'teleport to Xeric's Heart via Xeric's talisman' as a literal diary requirement -- i.e. owning the talisman is itself gated INTO one diary tier while also accelerating repeat access to a raid. Anchor_hint is soft rather than hard because nothing else in the KB requires possessing the talisman to proceed (Chambers of Xeric itself has alternate access routes: Lovakengj Minecart, fairy ring BLS).
